15th Naguri Hiking Tour: "Walk through Naguri Lake and Arima Gorge adorned with autumn colors."

Date & Time: Sunday, November 15, 2026 (Reiwa 8), 9:00 a.m.
Meeting Place: Nora Naguri Sawabi 3rd Parking Lot

Route: Nora Naguri → North shore of Naguri Lake → Canoe Workshop → Arima Gorge Fishing Spot → South shore of Naguri Lake → Nora Naguri
Distance: Approximately 9 kilometers
Duration: Approximately 3 hours

Fee: ¥100 (insurance, collected on the day)

What to Bring: Packed lunch, drinks, rain gear, Sugo-Ashi handbook and bear bell (if you have them), etc.

Registration Deadline: Friday, November 6, 2026

To Register: Contact Naguri District Administrative Center
• Phone: 042-979-1121
• Fax: 042-979-1113
• Email: naguri-center@city.hanno.lg.jp

Cancellation Check: On the day of the event, call Naguri District Administrative Center after 7:00 a.m. to confirm if the event is cancelled due to weather or other reasons.

Convenient Access: Take the Kokusai Kögyo Bus departing Hanno Station at 8:00 a.m.; you'll arrive at Nora Naguri Sawabi no Yu at 8:41 a.m.

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/soshikikarasagasu/kenkohukusibu/hokencenter/12652.html
